    • getModels

      public List<List<Extension<DungTheory>>> getModels(DungTheory theory) throws InvocationTargetException, IllegalAccessException
      Computes the ranking of all subsets of the given theory. The ranking is built by comparing extensions lexicographically with the configured base functions.
      Parameters:
      theory - a dung theory
      Returns:
      a list representing the ordering of all subsets of the given graph wrt. the ordering semantics
      Throws:
      InvocationTargetException - should never happen
      IllegalAccessException - should never happen
